ResumeInfo.title: ResumeInfo
ResumeInfo.description: Details extracted from the student's resume.

researchExperience.description: Array of research or laboratory accomplishments

projects.description: Array of key course or personal projects

leadership.description: Array of student organization or leadership details

isParsed.description: Flag to mark if parsed from raw resume

JobTarget.title: JobTarget
JobTarget.description: The targeted career role configured for the interview.

positionTitle.description: Name of position, internship, or research path

companyName.description: Target company, lab, or graduate school

interviewType.description: The type of interview vibe, e.g. behavioral, technical, general

difficulty.description: Beginner, standard, or challenging complexity level

focusCategory.description: Optional Albion focus or liberal arts category

SpeakingStats.title: SpeakingStats
SpeakingStats.description: Speech pace, pause, and filler word diagnostics

paceWpm.description: Speech pace in words per minute

longPausesCount.description: Number of significant pauses of 2s+ detected

fillerWordsCount.description: Total number of filler words spoken

fillerWordsList.description: List of distinct filler words used

volumeConsistency.description: Volume style feedback, e.g., steady, fluctuating, or low

eyeContactEstimatePercentage.description: Estimated average percentage of eye contact duration

nervousnessIndicators.description: Observed nervousness physical or audio ticks

QuestionFeedback.title: QuestionFeedback
QuestionFeedback.description: Constructive granular review of a single question answer

clarityComments.description: Critique of response layout and language flow

starAnalysis.description: Explicit STAR mapping assessment (situation, task, action, result) for behavioral prompts

InterviewQuestion.title: InterviewQuestion
InterviewQuestion.description: A distinct generated inquiry to ask the student

text.description: Literal text of the prompt question

category.description: Structural type of question, e.g. behavioral, technical, closing

FinalReport.title: FinalReport
FinalReport.description: Aggregated overall assessment of the completed session

contentQualityScore.description: Depth of facts and resume references (1-100)

personalizedAdvice.description: Director's final summation and encouraging notes

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Main parent profile details for the registered student

InterviewSession.title: InterviewSession
InterviewSession.description: Comprehensive document tracking progress, logs, and scoring of a single mock session

date.description: Formatted date string when interview was initiated

questions.description: Inquiry database compiled for this session

userAnswers.description: Map mapping question IDs to the student's answered scripts

feedbacks.description: Map mapping question IDs to specific QuestionFeedback

speakingStatsHistory.description: Map mapping question IDs to specific speech diagnostics stats

isCompleted.description: Flags if session reached full conclusion reporting

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles for authenticated Albion College students.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Granular, secure historic log records of completed mock interview run-throughs.
